q: A dissipative evolution equation generates a semigroup {S(t)}_{t≥0} on a Banach space X. The global attractor 𝒜 is the omega-limit set of any bounded absorbing set B:
opts: 𝒜 = {x : S(t)x ∈ B for all t}
exp: The global attractor is the omega-limit set of any absorbing set B: 𝒜 = ∩_{s≥0} cl(∪_{t≥s} S(t)B). This is compact, invariant (S(t)𝒜 = 𝒜), and attracts all bounded sets. Existence requires a compact absorbing set (obtained from energy estimates for dissipative PDEs).
